author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Raze

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friends. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host picks everything in the menus: Quick Match settings or the campaign stage. Friends are on the host's team in campaigns and team modes.

keys.does: Move; jump with W, Up or Space (twice to double jump).
Aim and shoot with your own mouse.

keys.key: Q or Shift, E or Enter

tips: Only the host can pause and use the end-of-match buttons; saves are the host's.
Losing the host ends the game.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.
New: not yet played by people on two PCs or over the internet. Tell us how it runs.

description: Raze (Armor Games, 2010): a run-and-gun shooter. Up to 4 players fight together in Quick Match and both campaigns, each with their own soldier and camera.
